title: RISK-BASED TEST FRAMEWORK FOR LLM FEATURES IN REGULATED SOFTWARE

bias_targets.methodology: Paired prompt testing by varying patient age in otherwise identical clinical scenarios, analyzing the outputs for differences in tone, content, and recommendation completeness.
